messages:
Maria (CS): Arcadia Logistics asked for a bilingual EN/ES reranker for order-routing docs. They want Private deployment with KMS/HSM, strong PII handling, and p50 latency <120ms. Elaine is our contact. Copying @Leo for eval details. https://arcadia.example/brief
Elaine (Arcadia PM): Thanks — priority: Spanish titles + addresses. Throughput ~100 req/s. Production SLA 99.9. We cannot share raw addresses but can provide anonymized samples.
AJ (AE): Noted. Customer prefers Private but wants cost comparison with Dedicated.
Leo (ML Eng): Quick clarifying q's: 1) Do they have labeled rerank pairs? 2) avg / max seq length? 3) any language split stats?
Elaine (Arcadia PM): We have ~25k paired rows from logs (EN/ES mixed). Avg length ~64 tokens, max ~210, most under 128. Labels are click-derived (noisy). We can supply anonymized tokenized samples + labeling schema.
Sam (Security): For Private + HSM: need DPA, KMS integration details, IP allowlist, and DLP for PII redaction. Also confirm data residency constraints (they have EU+US ops). @Maria add SOC2 checklist.
devops-bot: Deployment ticket created: /deployments/arcadia-2349 (private-vpc, kms-integrated, audit-logs enabled).
Leo (ML Eng): Proposed eval plan (initial):
```
eval_config:
  model_variants: [redwood-7b-q4, open-13b]
  metrics: [ndcg@10, mrr, latency_p50, rerank_precision]
  dataset: arcadia_anon_pairs_v1 (25k)
  batch_sizes: [1, 8, 32]
  safety_checks:
    - pii_redaction_score >= 0.98
    - hallucination_rate < 0.02
    - sample_review: 2000 manual checks (EN/ES split)
```
Leo (ML Eng): If labels are noisy we'll add a human-in-the-loop relabel subset (~2k) to get a reliable eval. Also need clear redaction test cases for addresses.
Maria (CS): Timeline request from customer: pilot next month. Elaine, can you confirm target dates? AJ, can we scope a 3-week pilot: tuning + eval + privacy/compliance review?
AJ (AE): Yes, I'll draft the SOW and pilot estimate. Will include cost for private infra + HSM hours.
Elaine (Arcadia PM): Target pilot start 2024-05-15. Expect initial eval results within 10 business days after you get the anonymized dataset.
Leo (ML Eng): 10 business days is tight but doable if we receive dataset by 2024-04-22 and have compute reserved. We'll need anonymized sample link + schema and any taxonomy for address tokens.
Sam (Security): I'll kick off the compliance intake. Requirement: signed DPA + customer KMS contact + network allowlist. Also will run a DLP scan on anonymized samples before ML team accesses them.
Maria (CS): Action items: - AJ (AE): SOW + pricing + pilot quote - Leo (ML Eng): eval plan + compute estimate + relabel plan - Sam (Security): compliance intake + DLP scan - Elaine (Arcadia PM): share anonymized dataset link + signer for DPA - devops-bot: provision private env (ticket exists)
AJ (AE): I'll circulate a draft SOW by EOD tomorrow.
Elaine (Arcadia PM): I'll get the dataset ready and send the DPA signer details today. Thanks, team.
Leo (ML Eng): One more note: for latency target we'll test with batch=1 and p50 target <120ms; will include quantized variant suggestions if needed.
Sam (Security): Also requesting that logs mask last 4 chars of order IDs in audit logs.
Maria (CS): Great. I'll follow up with a short kickoff call invite after AJ posts SOW. Keeping updates in this thread :thumbsup:
